Case Number: PPR-2016-01 Location: 919 W. Sierra Madre Avenue
APN: 8617-001-005
Applicant: California Grand Village Azusa Greens
The proposed project would involve construction of a 256-unit luxury independent living village for seniors and the reconfiguration of two holes of the Azusa Greens Golf Course. The project site encompasses 4.48 acres located at the southeast corner of W. Sierra Madre Avenue and N. Todd Avenue. The project would require a General Plan Amendment, Zone Change, Specific Plan, Tentative Parcel, and Environmental Impact Report. The property is zoned Recreation.
This is not a public hearing and the Planning Commission will not be making any decision on the commercial development at this time.
